1.read: Rounder crust that bulges at both ends and a wider, rounder body; still saucy with long drips and the fat drop. The mildest change.

2.read: Plump belly with a rounded tip and a thick pillowy crust wall: the softest silhouette of rounds 1-2, still saucy and pan-baked.

3.read: Crust drawn as puffy scalloped pillows like a pan pie wall, sauce piled on top and dripping; reads most clearly as deep dish.

4.read: Scalloped crust wall with a rolled end and loose sauce drips; the lumpiest, most pan-pie look.

round3.intent: Guide: a stubby plump wedge under a tall thick pan-crust wall, sauce piled on top and dripping down the front. Honest read: the guide shape was followed exactly and is far softer, but it has gone past a slice into a muffin or acorn; the saucy look and the heavy boots survive.

5.read: Glossy sauce piled on a thick crust cap, plump rounded body, heavy boots. Softest, and clearly saucy; reads more muffin than slice.

6.read: Same shape with darker, drippier sauce and a flatter paper finish.

7.read: Taller wall variant: the crust cap is deeper and the body shorter, so the most deep-dish and the least slice-like.

8.read: Taller-wall variant with deep red sauce and white gloves; the heaviest looking.

1.read: Rounded corners and a fuller body, crust edge thinner and smoother; the tip is only slightly droopy.

2.read: A thin plain crust edge (the rolled tube is gone) over a softly curved body; closest to the plain-crust note.

3.read: Thin crust edge that bows, with softly curved sides and a rounder tip; the floppiest of rounds 1-2, still stiff.

4.read: Thin, wide plain crust with a wavy edge, rounded corners and a cheese drip; plainest crust, little droop.

round3.intent: Guide: a very long, wide, thin slice with a plain flat crust strip; the front third folds under its own weight and the tip droops and curls. Honest read: the thin plain crust and the folded, drooping tip finally appear and it is clearly floppier, but the wide top gives a cup or bowl look and the tiny legs hang below it.

5.read: Thin plain crust strip, wide body, front folding over into a drooping, curling tip, wavy mouth kept. The floppiest by far.

6.read: Same fold lower down and longer: the tip hangs between the legs. More droop, more cup-like.

1.read: Puffy leopard-spotted crust with a bulging, sagging body and rounded tip; the softest outline of rounds 1-2.

2.read: Plump blistered crust, curved sides and a softly rounded tip; still reads as the same Contessa.

3.read: Very puffy cornicione with rounder edges; the leopard spotting stays bold and her smirk stays crisp.

4.read: Pillowy crust with a limper, drooping lower tip; more bend than the others.

round3.intent: Guide: a small rounded wedge with a puffy bubbly leopard-spotted rim, mozzarella and basil blobs, a soft belly curve. Honest read: the shape was followed and is much softer and rounder; the margherita reads as a plump shield with a puffy crust.

5.read: Puffy speckled crust over a red sauce shield with a cream mozzarella centre and basil dots; soft, round, on-model.

6.read: Deeper belly curve under a spotted crust; the roundest and plumpest.

slice-ny.current_read: Tommy's original pick, unchanged in the game.

1.read: Rounder crust and a plump rounded body, clearly softer yet still Vinny; the only round 1-2 option with a real silhouette change.

2.read: Same softening with a paler, creamier cheese and a slightly drooping tip.

round3.intent: Guide: his proportions with rounded corners and a slight soft bulge. Honest read: this overshot, since he is now a rounded shield with a flat crust cap; softer, but he lost his curled crust and his look, so only for a bolder change.

3.read: Rounded shield body, flat crust cap, one pepperoni near the point; very soft, less recognisably Vinny.

4.read: Slightly shallower bulge with white gloves; the closest of round 3 to him.
